limitations: LLM judge scores are not independent SQL correctness or human acceptance.
Golden context precision/recall measures reference logic coverage, not live numerical facts.
Faithfulness can penalize recommendations not entailed by SQL facts; inspect low scores.

metric_definitions.faithfulness: Unmodified Ragas whole-response statement entailment against original SQL contexts.
metric_definitions.factual_faithfulness: Scoped Ragas metric with factual statement extraction v1; keeps every empirical assertion including premises inside proposals. Excludes only pure suggestions without factual premises. Not directly comparable to whole-response faithfulness.
metric_definitions.sql_factual_faithfulness: Factual extraction plus SQL/provenance entailment instruction v1. Accounts for trusted scope, untruncated groups and measurement boundaries; not standard Ragas or comparable with v1 factual scores.

data_source: FixtureModel placeholder answer with frozen synthetic SQL evidence; no BigQuery executed
evidence_boundary: Successful judge connectivity test only. Not model answer quality or prompt improvement.
